name: Slic3D (Jaycar house brand)
summary: Budget PLA and PETG filament sold by AU/NZ electronics retailer Jaycar under Jaycar part numbers, very likely a Jaycar house brand. Offered on 1 kg 1.75 mm spools and as a spool-less refill; the contract extruder is undisclosed.

oem_relationships.notes: Inferred, not stated by an official source: products carry Jaycar part numbers (TL64xx), a MakerWorld spool model is titled 'SLIC3D Spool by JAYCAR', SimplyPrint shop links go to jaycar.co.nz, and no independent Slic3D site exists.
Jaycar is an electronics retailer with no known extrusion operation; no OEM has been identified.

product_lines.name: Basic PLA
product_lines.notes: 10 colours, 190-230 C; 1 kg 1.75 mm; also a spool-less refill version (e.g. Jaycar TL6476).

additional_notes: Same house-brand pattern as insignia, michaels and hobby-lobby. The Open Filament Database lists New Zealand as origin, which may reflect only the Jaycar NZ sales channel, so headquarters_country is omitted. Jaycar describes the range as budget-friendly; no prices were read. Also sold via jaycar.com.au.

provenance.conflicts: The house-brand inference is strong but no official source states it. The MakerWorld page and Jaycar listings were seen only as search snippets. Country of origin (NZ per OFD) unverified.
